u0: This is the ordinary in-progress phase: no box fall is currently awaiting recovery, and the exit has not yet been successfully reached with the box. The agent may already be carrying the box or may still need to pick it up, but it must eventually reach the exit while holding it. If the box falls again, picking it up becomes an immediate outstanding requirement.
u1: The box has slipped from the agent's hands and has not yet been recovered, so picking it up again is outstanding. Regaining the box away from the exit clears that lapse and returns the agent to ordinary progress toward the exit. The task can still be completed if the exit is reached with the box in hand; reaching the exit while still empty-handed leaves both the exit requirement and the fall recovery unresolved.
u2: The agent has reached the exit without the box, so the requirement to be holding the box in connection with the exit remains unmet. Completion can still occur if the box is subsequently held with no new fall pending. If the box falls while this obligation is unresolved, progress shifts to a further unfinished situation in which the fall must also be recovered.
u3: The task is complete: the exit has been reached and the box is in the agent's hands, satisfying the requirement to finish with the box, and any earlier fall has been recovered from. All required objectives have been met, so no further action is needed.
u4: The agent has reached the exit without the box while a fall remains unresolved, so both the exit-with-box requirement and the need to recover the box are outstanding. There is no separate progress available except to regain possession of the box. Once the box is held again, all requirements are satisfied and the task completes.
